components.css: .ds-app{font-family:var(--font-family, 'Medium', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--border-weak,#e2e8f0);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg-card,#fff);color:var(--title-card-color,rgba(17,24,39,1));text-decoration:none;transition:border-color 220ms ease,background-color 220ms ease}.ds-app:hover{border-color:var(--PrimaryColor,#c47a35)}.ds-app:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--PrimaryColor,#c47a35);outline-offset:4px}.ds-app-visual{height:10rem;background:var(--PrimaryColor-alpha-8,rgba(79,175,124,.08));color:var(--PrimaryColor,#c47a35)}.ds-app-visual svg{width:100%;height:100%;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;transition:transform 500ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-app-visual rect{fill:var(--bg-card,#fff);stroke-width:2}.ds-guide{opacity:.3}.ds-line{stroke-width:2.5;stroke-dasharray:1100}.ds-app:hover .ds-line,.ds-app:focus-visible .ds-line{animation:ds-trace 700ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-app:hover .ds-app-visual svg{transform:scale(1.035)}.ds-app-heading{padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 1rem}.ds-app h3{margin:0 0 .4rem;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600}.ds-app p{margin:0;color:var(--subtitle-color,#64748b);font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.65}.ds-app-cta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:1rem 1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border-weak,#e2e8f0);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600}@keyframes ds-trace{from{stroke-dashoffset:1100}to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-app,.ds-app-visual svg{transition:none}.ds-app:hover .ds-app-visual svg{transform:none}.ds-app:hover .ds-line,.ds-app:focus-visible .ds-line{animation:none}}

components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:var(--font-family, 'Medium', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;padding:.5rem;border:1px solid var(--border-weak,#e2e8f0);border-radius:14px;background:var(--bg-card,#fff)}.ds-nav a{padding:.75rem 1rem;border-radius:10px;color:var(--subtitle-color,#64748b);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--bg-section,#f8fafc);color:var(--title-card-color,rgba(17,24,39,1))}.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--PrimaryColor-alpha-8,rgba(79,175,124,.08));color:var(--title-card-color,rgba(17,24,39,1))}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--PrimaryColor,#c47a35);outline-offset:2px}.ds-divider{width:1px;height:1.5rem;background:var(--border-weak,#e2e8f0)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-home{width:100%}.ds-divider{display:none}.ds-nav a{padding:.65rem .8rem}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-details{font-family:var(--font-family, 'Medium', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);border-top:1px solid var(--border-weak,#e2e8f0);padding-block:1.25rem;color:var(--title-card-color,rgba(17,24,39,1))}.ds-details summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;list-style:none}.ds-details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-details summary svg{margin-inline-start:auto;transition:transform 220ms ease}.ds-details[open] summary{margin-block-end:1.5rem}.ds-details[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}.ds-details summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--PrimaryColor,#c47a35);outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-details summary svg{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-timeline{font-family:var(--font-family, 'Medium', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.25rem;padding:clamp(1.25rem,2vw,2rem);border:1px solid var(--quote-line,#e7e1da);border-radius:14px;background:var(--quote-paper,#fffdfa);color:var(--quote-ink,#272a2b);transition:border-color 180ms ease,background-color 180ms ease}.ds-timeline:hover,.ds-timeline:focus-within{border-color:var(--quote-copper,#a45e39)}.ds-timeline:focus-within{background:var(--quote-copper-soft,#f4e8df)}.ds-timeline h3{margin:0;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4}.ds-timeline a{color:var(--quote-copper-dark,#854725)}.ds-timeline a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--quote-copper,#a45e39);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-timeline{transition:opacity 100ms ease,border-color 100ms ease}}

narrative.overview: Scoped incumbent identity for Quote Show, Schedule, and Site & Team. The warm ink/copper dashboard surrounds legacy white task surfaces; this record does not replace other BuildHub modules' design rules.

rules.name: Source precedence
rules.body: Shell quote tokens and legacy module tokens coexist. Read the final matching declarations and imported styles before changing values.

dos: Do preserve real routes and quote ownership.
Do keep native disclosures, logical spacing, translations, and keyboard focus.
donts: Don't impose the launcher composition on unrelated screens.
Don't reinterpret the green legacy alpha family as copper.
Don't invent metrics or raster imagery.
